title: Best insulated tumbler on the market!
text: Best insulated tumbler on the market!. I live in a golf cart community in Florida and I had been looking for some kind of insulated cup to be able to use both in my cart, to take to the gym or even just laying out by the pool in the hot Florida sun. I love this cup. It keeps my beverages cool (it takes a while for the ice cubes to even start to melt), it's a great size and holds a lot, and my drinks taste fresh and clean. I pop this in the dishwasher (along with the cap and straw) and it comes out sparkling clean. Highly recommend this insulated cup.
